newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Aviatrans offers more cargo capacity in '9.
newsitem.headline: Russian Aviatrans offers more cargo capacity in '9.

text.p: Russia's Atran-Aviatrans charter cargo airline clocked up 72 million available freight tonne kilometres (AFTK) in 1996 compared with 68 million in the previous year, a senior company official said on Thursday.
Commercial director Alexander Selyan told Reuters that last year's AFTK matched the company's record set in 1994.
"We had a good last year and hope to repeat 1996's figures this year," he said.
Selyan said that Atran-Aviatrans saw stable cargo charters between Russia and European countries, but the market to South East Asian destinations was very volatile.
Privately owned Atran-Aviatrans was founded in 1990 and now operates eight Ilyushin Il-76, three Antonov An-32, six An-26 and eight An-12 freighters.
